entities.name: Moira
entities.description: Phyrexian spirit and wizard from Dominaria, a former necromancer of Urborg who came to free spirits.

entities.name: Ratadrabik
entities.description: Lich who trafficked in forced servitude of the dead.

entities.name: Teshar
entities.description: Fought beside Moira for the Phyrexians.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which Moira was compleated.

events.summary: A spell goes wrong and destroys Moira's body, making her a spirit.
events.quote: when a spell went wrong, her own body was destroyed

events.summary: Moira turns to helping spirits pass on freely.
events.quote: Moira changed her ways and turned her talents toward helping spirits pass on freely.

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Moira is compleated and joins the Phyrexian armies.
events.quote: Moira was compleated and joined the Phyrexian armies.

relations.note: In conflict over servitude of the dead.
relations.quote: which often brought her into conflict with Ratadrabik
